card.name: Linking words in dosing tables
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "to" in ranges, "is"/"are", and the period after a bracketed section reference, in dosing tables and prescribing-information text.

modes.label: Range "to"
modes.description: The word "to" between two values in a weight, age or dose range in a table.

modes.label: Period after cross-reference
modes.description: A sentence-ending period right after a bracketed "see Clinical Pharmacology" or similar reference.
modes.example: [see Clinical Pharmacology (12.3)]<< .>> Intervention: Consider this when selecting an oral

modes.label: Verb or participle in a table sentence
modes.description: A verb like "is" or "are", or the word "defined", within a short dosing statement.
modes.example: Symptoms of overdose<< are>> consistent with the known adverse reactions of es

card.plain: It fires on little connecting words and punctuation in dosing tables and label text, such as the "to" in a range.
